headline: Hemingway in Peru
author: El Búho
content: This Owl has long known that among great writers, American Ernest Hemingway was renowned for being rugged, wild, drunkard, and womanizer according to critics. His novels were almost autobiographical but masked with fiction due to his memories. For instance, his novel ‘The Sun Also Rises’ tells the story of a journalist injured during World War I, similar to Hemingway’s own experiences...
